name: Beam
author: James Myers
description: AirDrop for Omarchy. Beam speaks the LocalSend protocol, so your Linux desktop shows up in the share sheet of the iPhones, Android phones, Macs and Windows machines around it - and they show up in yours. Peer to peer over your own LAN, encrypted, no account, no cloud, no relay.

schema.label: Device name
schema.description: What other devices call this machine. Empty picks a friendly two-word name and remembers it.

schema.label: Save files to
schema.description: Where accepted files land. Empty means ~/Downloads.

schema.label: Accept without asking
schema.description: Take every incoming file with no prompt. Convenient on a home network, reckless on a shared one. Off by default.

schema.label: Require a PIN
schema.description: Senders must supply this PIN before this machine will even show them a prompt. Empty means no PIN.

schema.label: Invisible
schema.description: Stop announcing on the network. You can still send; nobody can see you to send to you.

schema.label: Notify on arrival
schema.description: Raise a desktop notification when files finish arriving.
